newsitem.title: POLAND: Boar which broke into Polish police hq killed.
newsitem.headline: Boar which broke into Polish police hq killed.

text.p: Police tracked down and shot a wild boar which broke into their regional headquarters in the southeastern Polish city of Lublin, private Radio Zet reported on Friday.
It said the boar smashed the glass of one locked door to the building on Thursday night, got in through an open door and left after knocking over furniture in a waiting room.

"In the morning police launched a search and found the animal in a yard across the road, where it had bitten a dog, while the terrified owner with her children had barricaded herself in her house," said the radio's Lublin reporter.
Police killed the boar with a shotgun and a veterinary laboratory is running tests to determine whether it had rabies.
